skippedTests.description: native macOS arm64 export and copied-app rejection controls
skippedTests.reason: MACOS_EXPORT_TEMPLATE is unset; native export requires the reviewed Godot arm64 Release template

topLevel: a good manifest has no problem, and each way of being wrong is named
the three manifests are read from <directory>/<arm>, with their paths resolved to absolute ones
prepare() registers what the manifests say, with the seed, the game's hashes and the instrument from the Debug launcher's sources
prepare() refuses, naming the arm and the file, when a manifest is missing, is wrong or does not match its file, and nothing runs
launch() runs the executable of the arm with the scenario's arguments, with no -s and an absolute --out, in a directory outside the .app and the exports
a real process of the fake .app: the report is read, the launch has the interface's shape, and the working directory is the launcher's own
a process that exits with an error, writes no report or writes a report of its own is passed on as it came
a process killed while it wrote its report leaves a file that is not JSON: no report, the file is kept, the log says where, and cleanup() leaves it
a file that changed between prepare() and launch() makes launch() throw, and the process is not started
a process that outlives the launcher's timeout is killed and is reported as timed out, and only then
cleanup() removes the launcher's own directory and nothing of the exports
the campaign reads and validates the exports, then refuses because the instrument's self-check cannot run in a template, before anything is launched or written
the command line: --build release needs --exports, which a Debug rehearsal does not take, and the campaign refuses with the self-check's reason and runs nothing
a campaign plays the protocol's sequence in both lanes, once per slot, one process at a time, balanced by position, and its campaign is in the format the analysis reads
a load above the limit, an undrawn presented window and an incomplete window are each rejected with their reason, kept in the raw data and redone in the same slot
an error and a process that wrote no report are rejected by the errors rule and redone; the one without a report is in the campaign's unreported, counts in its slot and in the report
a process that timed out and one that exited 0 without a report are unreported too, each with how it ended
a process killed while it wrote its report (a file that is not JSON) is unreported too, and its log says where the launcher kept the file
three attempts that wrote no report in a slot stop the campaign by the attempts rule of the analysis, as three rejected executions do
three rejected attempts in a slot stop the campaign: the later slots do not run, the stop is recorded and the analysis produces no statistic
the other game once is redone; the second time in the same arm stops the campaign
a scenario that waited with numbers other than the protocol's stops the campaign, chosen by the problem's code, and the analysis alone would not have seen it
a protocol whose load limit is not a finite positive number is refused before anything runs, because the wait could never tell a quiet machine
the wait for the load reads it every few seconds until it is under the limit, records the wait, and a wait that runs out lets the attempt run to be judged by the rule
a campaign interrupted after the k-th attempt, or twice, resumes from the first open slot and ends as a campaign that was never interrupted
a campaign is not resumed if the protocol, the script, the binary, the package or the instrument has another hash, or the options are not the same; nothing runs and the state stays as it was
the self-check is the gate: if it fails nothing runs, the stop is recorded, and a resume repeats it until it passes
an engine or a renderer other than the one the self-check ran on stops the campaign
the self-check runs in the lane the launcher runs in: a window for a launcher that opens one, headless for one that does not, and a check in the other lane is not the campaign's renderer
the unlimited lane whose vsync does not read back DISABLED is N/A and is not run further, and says so
a rehearsal redoes nothing, is marked as one and says in its deviations that it is not a result
the command line: --build debug and --slots are for a rehearsal, the numbers are checked, and a campaign needs its build and its directory
a file is written whole or not at all
the window rule reads the numbers the protocol states in words, and refuses an amendment that rewrites a sentence
the frames of each window, on a trace written by hand
on the trace of a whole execution the windows have the occurrences the protocol counts
the numbers the scenario waits with, in GDScript, are the protocol's
the amendments of the protocol that the scenario follows are in the protocol it is run against
the kinds of event the scenario traces are the ones the window rule reads
the player's constants are the soak's own
the arguments after the executable enter the scenario as the main loop: no -s, the user arguments after --, and an absolute --out
the entry is two lines that extend the scenario, the main scene is one empty node, and the settings name both
override.cfg is left out of the package's hash and the entry, the scene and the settings are in the scenario's
the Debug launcher says that the process was killed at its timeout, and only then
the Debug launcher takes a report that is not JSON for no report, keeps the file beside itself and says where in the log
a CPU time becomes integer microseconds as Math.round(totalMs * 1000)
the load average, the exit and the log of a Godot process are read as the errors rule asks
the cost of reading stats() is taken from the record of the slice that delivered the hooks, with two digits
the replay's golden hash is read from the test that fixes it
the scenario's reports, assembled into a campaign, pass the format and the analysis rejects each execution as a Debug build
a window the scenario could not measure has no occurrence in the campaign, and the campaign says why apart
the FPS without a limit is the frames of the measured occurrences over the time they took, and only a vsync read back as DISABLED has one
the windows are derived from the trace and the samples, and a report that cannot be analysed says why
an event burst that never settles leaves the window one occurrence short, and the analysis calls the execution incomplete
the runner of this part runs only the rehearsal
